sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Folding car key (Car) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A folding car key with locking buttons.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - This key does currently not open any lock.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: This key used to open the locked trunk of a car in the dormitory parking lot on Customs, which gives access to a Grenade box. This trunk is now unlocked by default, no longer requiring the key to be opened.
